subject: prd/local-git-codehost
statement: Require the configured mainline ref on the selected bare origin before opening or preparing a local draft; if absent, refuse with an actionable first-push remedy. Keep FR-9's base-free proof for that separate first mainline push, then use normal history gates. The already initialized AEC origin needs no additional mainline commit.
rationale: Drafts should use the normal prepared-mainline path after the first mainline push.
